title: Quality of Life, Lifestyle, and Psychosocial Factors in Patients With Melanoma
official: Quality of Life, Lifestyle, and Psychosocial Factors in Patients With Melanoma
summary: This study investigates the extent to which lifestyle factors including mental health, social support, diet, and exercise are associated with quality of life and melanoma patient outcomes. Knowledge gained from this study may be used to guide the design of prospective clinical trials of lifestyle interventions to improve the outcomes of melanoma patients and assist doctors in counseling their patients.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of melanoma, precursor lesions, and associated cutaneous pathology
* Able to read and understand English
* Willing to complete an online or paper survey
